document.title: Eval harness: stop the CLI hunt, run graders without tools
document.summary: The producer prompt names the injected `node <abs>/dist/cli/main.js` command as the built CLI. Graders get the packet inline and `tools: []`. Agent runs record tool calls so the eval line can print CLI-hunt and grader-tool counts.
document.why: [#97](source:s1) cuts CI eval cost: the producer prompt was sending the agent to verify the CLI path, and graders with `read`/`grep`/`glob`/`ls` were walking the work tree.

sources.title: Eval harness: stop the CLI hunt in the producer prompt, run graders without tools
sources.gist: CI cost, not the user path: state the injected CLI as a fact, and run graders on an inline packet with no tools.

sources.label: PR #100
sources.title: Eval harness: stop the CLI hunt, run graders without tools
sources.gist: Implements #97 in scripts/eval/: producer prompt, tool-less graders, and tool-call telemetry.

lookFor: [#97](source:s1) says graders without tools must still grade correctly. If claim or grouping signals drop, the packet or prompt needs the missing facts inline.
[#97](source:s1) asks for before/after CLI-hunt steps and grader tokens. `formatRunTotals` is the on-branch measurement; it is not a pass/fail.

groups.title: Record tool calls on each agent run
groups.why: Later groups print CLI-hunt and grader-tool counts. That needs `onStep` traces on `AgentRunResult`.
groups.summary: `runLocalAgent` records assistant steps and tool names plus a short detail, and `isCliHuntCall` classifies dist/CLI hunts.
lookFor: Subtle. `glob **/*` is not a CLI hunt unless the pattern names dist, cli/main, or package.json.

groups.title: Name the injected CLI as a built fact
groups.why: [#97](source:s1) says “The CLI named in the skill is the local build” sent the producer hunting for a path, and once built the reviewed repo’s older CLI.
groups.summary: `producerPrompt` takes `cliPath` and tells the agent that `node <abs>/dist/cli/main.js` is the CLI, it is already built, and it must run that command as written.
lookFor: The producer `review` and `validate` shell commands should be `node /…/dist/cli/main.js`, not a build of the work tree’s own CLI.

groups.title: Grade from an inline packet with no tools
groups.why: [#97](source:s1) says graders were about 79% of eval tokens because they had `read`/`grep`/`glob`/`ls` and walked the work tree.
groups.summary: `groupingPrompt` and `prosePrompt` embed the packet. `GRADER_TOOLS` is empty, so `runGrader` offers no built-in tools.
lookFor: Subtle. `tools: []` is deny-all. Omitting `tools` would restore the default toolset.

commits.subject: Keep the prose grader's ask list and tighten CLI-hunt matching.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Restore the frozen-source / summary / lookFor questions in the inline packet prompt. Count glob as a CLI hunt only when the pattern names dist, cli/main, or package.json, not a generic **/*.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Stop the eval CLI hunt and run graders with no tools.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The producer prompt now states the injected `node <abs>/dist/cli/main.js` path as a built fact. Graders get the packet inline and an empty tool list so they cannot walk the work tree.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
